tools.name: submit_project_enquiry
tools.description: Send a software project enquiry to Order Group on the user's behalf. A person replies by e-mail within 48 hours on business days. Confirm the e-mail address and the message with the user before calling, and show them the 'relay_to_user' text from the result.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: List Order Group's published case studies (title, URL, short description), optionally filtered by a keyword such as 'fintech', 'energy', 'IoT' or 'mobile'.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "submit_project_enquiry" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Send a software project enquiry to Order Group on the user's behalf. A person replies by e-mail within 48 hours on business days. Confirm the e-mail address and…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_case_studies · Public sink: submit_project_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_case_studies · Public sink: submit_project_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
